newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-KLUIVERT SCORES FIRST GOAL OF SEASON IN AJAX WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLUIVERT SCORES FIRST GOAL OF SEASON IN AJAX WIN.

text.p: Patrick Kluivert scored his first goal of the season in Ajax Amsterdam's a 2-0 win over bottom-of-the-table RKC Waalwijk in a Dutch first division match on Thursday.
Kluivert, who went on as subtitute in the second half, proved he is on the road to recovery after a severe knee injury kept him sidelined for over two months by scoring in the 83rd minute.
Ronald de Boer scored the opening goal from close range in the 10th minute.
Despite Kluivert's return, coach Louis van Gaal, in his 250th match in charge of Ajax, was forced to reshuffle his lineup due to several injuries.
Marc Overmars, who has indicated he probably will not stay with the club until the end of his contract, was again sidelined through injury.
Dutch news agency ANP reported Ajax were unwilling to let Overmars go before July 2000, when his contract expires.
Ajax jumped one place to fifth overall, still trailing league leaders PSV Eindhoven by seven points.
